ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, \( \triangle ADE \cong \triangle BCF \), \( AD = 10 \) cm, \( CD = 6 \) cm, then what is the length of \( BD \)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ADE \cong \triangle BCF$,\\
it follows that $AD = BC = 10\text{cm}$,\\
Given that $BD = BC - CD$, and $CD = 6\text{cm}$,\\
we have $BD = 10 - 6 = \boxed{4}\text{cm}$.
